import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const arrange = () => ({ application: { run: () => 1 }, repository: { count: () => 0 } });

describe('a handler', () => {
  it('runs', () => {
    const { application, repository } = arrange();
    const [first, second] = [1, 2];
    const {
      application: { run },
    } = arrange();
    expect(application.run()).toBe(first);
    expect(repository.count()).toBe(0);
    expect(run()).toBe(second - 1);
  });
});
